system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Sarutobi are trained and skilled in a variety of tools and weapons and you are no different. When you take a long rest, you can perform a family ritual, calling on the blessings of the will of fire to grant you the mastery needed to use these tools of war to maintain the fires of will.

Select one Weapon Group or one Weapon Property. All weapons part of the chosen group or that share the chosen property that you wield become Flame Blessed until you complete a long rest. Weapons that are Flame Blessed gain the following benefits:

You cannot be disarmed of Flame Blessed weapons unless you are incapacitated.

Weapon attacks with Flame Blessed weapons can use your Taijutsu, Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier.

You gain a rank of Mastery to [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage] if a Flame Blessed weapon with the Unarmed property) that you deal.
